name: fenceos-assistant
description: Sets up a fence company in FenceOS through the signed-in browser: a first look around, then products, prices, gates, supplier costs, BOM recipes, mappings and locations, with approval at every step.

interface.shortDescription: Set up FenceOS through your browser with approval at every step.
interface.longDescription: One setup assistant with two modes. Getting started looks at your account and suggests what to do first. Catalog setup builds your fence types, gates, add-ons, prices, supplier material costs, BOM recipes, mappings, and location availability, one fence family at a time, and checks prices and margins against the material lists. It works only in your signed-in FenceOS tab and asks before anything is saved.
defaultPrompt: Help me get set up in FenceOS.
Set up all our fence types and gates so we can start quoting.
Set up a fence family from my supplier price sheet.
